title: The 5 Signs of a Good Wife

sense.text:
God is speaking straight to the women: “Rise up, ye women that are at ease; hear my voice, ye careless daughters; give ear unto my speech.” You women that are at ease with the liberal things here in America, you a nurse, you got a good job, you own your house -- the Most High says rise up, ye women that are at ease.

So what is God doing? He is creating a situation for you black and Hispanic women here in America for you not to be at ease no more. Trump's Board of Education is moving to declassify nursing as a profession, and that goes into occupational therapy, speech therapy, the RNs, all them things that sisters do. Nursing is one of the careers that pulls our people up out of poverty; a lot of our sisters go into nursing and think they independent -- I don't need no man, I'm a nurse, I'm making my own money. They get a good job, good credit, able to get a house and pay a mortgage. If it is declassified you don't qualify for them programs no more, you got to come up out of pocket, and who it is going to affect is our people.

You live carelessly here in America, and God calls you careless daughters.

“Many days and years” -- it is going to get worse and worse, and it is going to last years and years. It is not going to get better.

The trouble and affliction that is upon our people is going to last years, it is going to get worse and worse and worse, and it is going to intensify in the end. And it is going to be like that until Christ return.

When we tell you all oppression is coming, some of you all not paying attention. Pay attention to what is going on in the world.

“And moreover I saw under the sun the place of judgment, that wickedness was there; and the place of righteousness, that iniquity was there.” The place of judgment is the church; back then it was talking about the temple.

God says wickedness is there, and God says that iniquity was there. Being a realist about it: you brothers and sisters that is amongst us, there is wickedness here and there is unrighteousness here. Some of you all have come amongst us and you have not repented of your sins and you here.

“I said in mine heart, God shall judge the righteous and the wicked” -- so the time is coming when the Lord will bring judgment. “for there is a time there for every purpose and for every work.” There is a time for every purpose and every work.

So those of you brothers and sisters that is in the midst of fornication, that is in the midst of adultery, that is gossiping: get yourself together, because we know that you all are here and we know you all dealing with things. What you all must do is come to us for help, come and confess your faults, confess the things you are dealing with, and we could help you and we could also pray for you.

A lot of brothers and sisters have been put out of the congregation. Some of you all have been in the truth for years and you have fallen, and the key thing brothers and sisters fall into is fornication, sexual sins.

“The steps of a good man are ordered by the Lord: and he delighteth in his way.” If you a good man, your steps, your walk in this truth, it will be ordered by the Lord. That goes back to a man's going being of the Lord: the Lord going to order your steps.

And God is going to delight in your ways.

“Though he fall, he shall not be utterly cast down: for the Lord upholdeth him”. Though you fall. For those of you brothers and sisters, some of you all have fallen, you are caught up in your sins, and you online right now -- we put you out of the school. Though you fall, you are not going to be utterly cast down.

What does it mean that you are not going to be utterly cast down? To be utterly cast down means you leave the truth, you go back into the world and you just be wicked. If you are a good man, if you are a just man, you are not going to go back into the world and just be wicked. Even though you make a mistake, even if Satan came and deceived you and you fell into some sin, you are not going to leave this truth. You going to take your correction and you going to get yourself right.

So you could get back up. Remember that.

precepts.why:
“Brethren, if a man be overtaken in a fault, ye which are spiritual, restore such an one in the spirit of meekness.” That is why he is not going to utterly be cast down: the brothers that is spiritual will restore you in the spirit of meekness.

That is how it is set up among us. Once you brothers and sisters get caught up in your sin, you confess and you forsake, and we going to put godly brothers and sisters around you to help you. If you is put out of here and you acknowledge the wrongs that you did, we going to have a spiritual brother or sister deal with you to restore you. But if you don't acknowledge nothing and you don't see you're wrong, we ain't having nobody talk to you. You could stay out there until you acknowledge where you went wrong, whether it is murmuring, gossiping, whatever it is. Unless you acknowledge what you did wrong, we not assigning nobody to talk to you.

So how can the Lord uphold you if you fall? Exactly that way: there will be a support team. The Lord upholds you by putting godly men around you to help you, and that is what keeps you from going back into the world. A lot of brothers and sisters is falling into all type of different sins, in all these states, and the deacons and captains got to be dealing with it during the week.

“Now unto him that is able to keep you from falling” -- the Lord is the one that is able to keep us from falling, “and to present you faultless before the presence of his glory with exceeding joy.” That is who is going to present us before the presence of his glory with joy. So the reason why you don't fall is because the Lord prevent you from falling.

It is said that if it were possible they shall deceive the very elect. The Lord know who his elect is; you don't know who the elect is, but the Lord knows, and the Lord is going to make sure his elect does not fall. Like with Joshua the high priest in the book of Zechariah: Joshua had on filthy garments, he was in the midst of evil -- the same thing read in Ecclesiastes, that in the place of judgment and in the place where there is righteousness there is also wickedness. And the Lord had to rebuke Satan, and the Lord had mercy on Joshua. Why? Because he was a chosen vessel, one of the Most High's elect.

So the Lord prevent his elect from falling. If you going off, he going to whoop your behind and bring you back in line.

sense.text:
“For a just man falleth seven times, and riseth up again: but the wicked shall fall into mischief.” A just man is somebody that's doing what's lawful and right. And a just man will fall. How can a just man fall? A just man could fall.

Here is an example. A brother inside this body, you a just man, you keeping the commandments, you doing what's lawful and right. But you ain't had a wife in six years, seven years. You've been abstinent, you've been maintaining. Here comes Satan on your job, line you up nice, you entertain it -- and guess what, you gave in to your temptation and you fell. But if a just man fall, he not going to say, you know what, let me keep having sex with this woman. He's going to stop it and he's going to go to the Lord and ask for forgiveness, and he's going to confess his faults. We might put him out of the congregation for a time, but he's going to get back up -- back up in keeping the commandments, in righteousness. King David fell. Solomon fell. Samson fell. In this flesh you are susceptible to make mistakes. The thing is, when you fall, you riseth up again: you going to rise up back and keep keeping the commandments.

“but the wicked shall fall into mischief.” If you wicked, you fall into your sins, we put you up out of here, and you continue in them sins -- well, they put me out, so let me keep having sex with the chick on my job. Some of you sisters, we put you out for fornication and you say, I'm already put out, so I'm going to keep having sex with the dude. No, you going to fall into mischief, meaning you going to regress, you going to keep doing the wickedness. Then you going to go back into the world, and then you going to be on some YouTube page talking about how we is a cult and that we evil. We already know. Many are called but few are chosen, and it is already said that in the last days many shall depart from the faith.

For those of you that leave the truth, you don't hurt us. You condemning yourself. When you up and leave and you speak evil, it doesn't affect us, because it is already told us that you will do that. You didn't leave us. You left Christ, you left the body of Christ, and there's a judgment for that. We did you no wrong, we did nothing to you, but you allowed Satan to deceive you in your mind, and now you on Mark Riser's platform or somebody's platform talking about how they did this and they said this and they a cult. You going to have to give account in the day of judgment, because you spit on the Lord that brought you into this truth.

precepts.why:
“But if a man be just, and do that which is lawful and right” -- that is what it is to be just. If you are just, you're going to do that which is lawful and right.

This breakdown of what a just man is came from the Bishop, and it had not been pulled in years.

So read Proverbs back with it: for a just man falleth seven times. A just man is somebody that's doing what's lawful and right. You're doing what's lawful and right, you a just man -- and a just man will still fall.

“The words of the Lord are pure words: as silver tried in a furnace of earth, purified seven times.” The words of the Lord is pure words; these scriptures is pure. The silver that's tried in the furnace of earth is talking about the elect, the righteous. All of us will be tried. You will be tried by your personal sins, you will be tried in your marriage, you'll be tried by how you deal with each other.

“purified seven times.” What does it mean when it says purified seven times? Meaning you could fall seven times. You that silver, you got to be purified seven times.

“Thou shalt keep them, O Lord, thou shalt preserve them from this generation for ever.” So the Lord will preserve you if you fall and you get up back. And that seven time does not necessarily mean seven. It mean a number of time; you could fall more than seven times. It is a completion of number.

sense.text:
“Marriage is honourable in all, and the bed undefiled: but whoremongers and adulterers God will judge.” Marriage is honourable. But marriage is only honourable if that brother or that sister do the right thing, if they do what's honourable. If you're not an honourable brother and an honourable sister, your marriage is not honourable. And if your father does not bless that union, the marriage is not honourable -- whether it is your physical biological father that is in the truth, or the elders of the congregation that bless the marriage.

You all don't understand the heaviness behind blessing a marriage or blessing the children. Isaac blessed Jacob and he blessed Esau, and the blessing that Isaac gave to Jacob established him: he became chosen, God was with him. If you want God to show you mercy and God to bless you, you need your father to bless you. You need your father or the elders to pray for you and bless you.

Why this matters so much is because, in order to have a strong nation, the family must be strong. In order for the nation of Israel to be strong, you sisters have to be good wives. The family structure must be strong, because a nation starts with man, woman, family.

Marriage is only honourable when you make it honourable. You got to be righteous, you got to deal right with each other. Don't expect the marriage to be honourable when you all keep fighting all the damn time, when the sister keep disrespecting her husband, when she don't listen. That's not honourable. A lot of you all get married up inside here and some of you all marriages is not honourable: your wife disrespect you, you ask her to bring you some food and she said get it yourself. Your marriage is not honourable because you are not making it honourable. It don't just become honourable. The only way the marriage going to become honourable is when that man and that woman work and build that marriage together, by dealing right with each other and by applying the scriptures in that union. And don't think because you marry your brother in the truth everything going to be all right, that everything should be perfect in my life from now on and I should have the perfect marriage. There's no such thing as a perfect marriage.

The leaders cannot fix your marriage. The counsel is given before you come together, because the two of you might not be compatible. When the leadership is looking at the brothers and sisters, we're looking at compatibility spiritually as well as in terms of your personal life: does a brother have his stuff together, does a sister have hers together, is there things spiritually that she needs to work on before we put the two of you together. We know the brothers' personal life, what they're battling with, their shortcomings, as well as the sisters'. Put two people together that's bringing baggage into the relationship and it is going to be chaotic, and we cannot counsel that. You're supposed to fix it before you come together, so that there's less issues. We could give you the scriptures, we could give you advice, but it is up to you. If you honourable and you godly, you will apply God's word and use that to fix your marriage. A man must rule his house. You got to fix your wife -- you want me to fix your wife for you? Then her desire will be unto me and not unto you. Don't come to us to fix your wife. You fix her. You work together and use the word of God and fix it.

Honourable also covers what a brother brings into the marriage. If you as a man dealing with erectile dysfunction, should you marry a sister without letting her know? That's dishonourable. That's not just you being dishonourable, that's deceit, and that's not just deceit, that's oppression -- that's like you trying to oppress the sister. Brothers should not be getting married to sisters without letting them know that condition. Talk to the sister: yo, listen, I'm dealing with this. She might say, okay, let's go to the doctor together and see what could be done, you could take medication, change your diet, and I don't care about stuff like that. Then you all working, she know about it. But don't go into a marriage with deceit, with lies, talking about I don't know what happened, I'm just nervous, when you know you got erectile dysfunction. And it doesn't excuse the wife going outside of marriage and committing adultery just because he has it. It's still adultery. Adultery is adultery, no matter how you look at it. Don't let the thought come in a sister's mind that God might cosign me stepping outside of my marriage because of that. No. Fast and pray and look for things that's going to help your husband out, rather than looking down on him or looking for another man.

“and the bed undefiled.” In order for the bed not to be defiled -- meaning the man not to step out or the woman not to step out -- what got to take place is the verse above it: the marriage got to be honourable. If you all not dealing right with each other and you dealing evil with each other, then the other part come into play and the bed will be defiled. You dealing evil with the sister, you beating her: the bed will be defiled. A sister got a loud mouth, she can't control herself, she disrespectful, she not giving her man no sex: down the line the bed will become defiled. Why? Because you all have an unhealthy, dishonourable marriage, and you all can't stand each other.

“but whoremongers and adulterers God will judge.” God will judge you, man. So to keep away from that judgment, you got to make your marriage honourable, so the bed does not become defiled.

precepts.why:
“For the blessing of the father establisheth the houses of children”. So who establishes the house of the children, the house of the daughters? The father does that.

This is one aspect of marriage being honourable in all, and the bed undefiled: the father is the one that give away the daughter in marriage. It's an honourable thing to go to the father and ask for the daughter in marriage.

That is why a union the father has not blessed is not honourable. The blessing of the father is what establishes the house.

“Rebuke not an elder, but intreat him as a father”. So what are the elders? The elders in Israel United in Christ, the brothers that's over the congregation, the captains, the leaders over the congregations -- they are fathers.

So when the Bible says marriage is honourable in all, and the bed undefiled, it is the father who gives away the daughter, and where there is no biological father in the truth, the elders of the congregation stand in that place and bless the marriage.

That is why you go to the father or you go to the elders. Either way, a father blesses that union, and that is what makes it honourable.

“And if a man entice a maid that is not betrothed, and lie with her, he shall surely endow her to be his wife.” To entice a maid is to seduce. If a man seduce a woman that is not betrothed and he lie with her, he should take her to be his wife.

Now is this the way you supposed to go about getting married? What did the brother do wrong here? He did not go to the father. He seduced the sister. You know dudes be up in these sisters' head -- yo, you so beautiful -- and the sister all giggling and stuff, and you got seduced. That's not honourable. It's not honourable to go behind a father's back and have sex with his daughter and then come to him and say, I'm going to take your daughter to be my wife because I had sex with her.

Here is the personal business behind that. My mother was 18, my father probably was 19. He got her pregnant and then he came to my grandfather and said, Mr. So and so, I love your daughter, I got her pregnant and I want to marry her. You know what my grandfather did? He hit him with a pipe over his head. Why did he do that? Because what my father did was dishonourable. You do not defile somebody's daughter and then come and say, yo, I defiled your daughter, your daughter is pregnant, I've been sexing her and I'm going to take her to be my wife. That's dishonourable. That's not an honourable marriage. That's why the scripture says a man that does that cannot put away that woman all his days, because what he did was evil.

“If her father utterly refuse to give her unto him, he shall pay money according to the dowry of virgins.” The father is pissed. He said, I don't like you, I'm not giving you my daughter -- you sex my daughter, got her pregnant, then you want to come. The scripture say you got to pay money if the father refused. That was the law back then. That law is not honourable. It's for negroes, always on the street trying to pick up sisters on the corner; you come out of your car in the store and dudes trying, hey, what's up, what's your name, can I get your Instagram. So don't go reading that law and think, oh, I'm going to apply Exodus 22:16.

The reason this is being brought up is because it been happening in IUIC. You had couple brothers go behind fathers' backs and dealt with their daughters, and not just the physical father but the leaders of the school. Some of you brothers and sisters, you all DMing each other on the low, y'all linking up with each other on the low, and y'all having sex with each other on the low, and you all think we don't know. We know. The Lord will always reveal you. That's dishonourable. If you all like each other, just get married. Go to the father, go to the elders -- I want to marry this sister. We not going to hold her back from you if your stuff is in order, meaning you could take care of her. As any father that have a daughter, when somebody come for their daughter, we make sure, yo, you can take care of my daughter, are you a good brother, and we going to give her to you. But do not sneak around DMing on Instagram and linking up and having sex with each other, and then when you get found out now you want to apply Exodus 22:16.

Those backdoor marriages are not blessed. A lot of time God does put an evil spirit in that marriage, where the sister disrespectful and the brother dealing with her evil, and things always be going wrong in that marriage. Why? Because you was not honourable, your marriage is not honourable. Those of you brothers and sisters that is how you got your wife, you better pray to God and ask God for forgiveness, and go to the father and ask the father for forgiveness and ask the father for a blessing: please, Father, I know I messed up, but please bless our union, ask God to have mercy on your daughter and on myself. That's the only way you could fix it. If you just go and marry her and you don't make amends with the father, that marriage will be a disaster, and we see it happen over and over and over in the body.

Some of you sisters, you dumb, stupid sisters that allow a brother to seduce you. Yes, you dumb and stupid. Here is what came of it when it happened to Jacob's daughter.

“And Dinah the daughter of Leah, which she bare unto Jacob, went out to see the daughters of the land.” She went out playing with the daughters of the children of the land. “And when Shechem the son of Hamor the Hivite, prince of the country, saw her, he took her, and lay with her, and defiled her.” When it say he took her, it didn't mean he raped her. He seduced her and she gave it up, and he defiled her. Did he go to Jacob and ask Jacob for his daughter? No. This dude is a prince; he went and he had sex with her and he defiled her. “And his soul clave unto Dinah the daughter of Jacob, and he loved the damsel, and spake kindly unto the damsel.” He loved her. If it was rape, if he took her and beat her and raped her, he wouldn't love her. But he loved Dinah. And spake kindly unto the damsel -- yo, you so beautiful, girl. He was seducing her. That's some of you sisters. “And Shechem spake unto his father Hamor, saying, Get me this damsel to wife.” So after he had sex with her, now he go to his father: I want to wifey her, I want to make her my wife, I love her.

Now see what it brought. “The sons of Jacob came upon the slain, and spoiled the city, because they had defiled their sister. They took their sheep, and their oxen, and their asses, and that which was in the city, and that which was in the field, And all their wealth, and all their little ones, and their wives took they captive”. The sons of Jacob here is Levi and Simeon. They went and they slew everybody in that city. They told them, get circumcised and then we going to allow our daughter to marry your son, and when everybody in the city got circumcised they went in there and killed all the men. “And Jacob said to Simeon and Levi, Ye have troubled me to make me to stink among the inhabitants of the land, among the Canaanites and the Perizzites: and I being few in number, they shall gather themselves together against me, and slay me; and I shall be destroyed, I and my house.” They going to gather themselves together against me and kill me, and me and my whole house will be destroyed.

“And they said, Should he deal with our sister as with an harlot?” That is Simeon and Levi's answer, and that is the whole point. Imagine how hurt Jacob and his sons felt when they find out Dinah went and gave it up to this heathen, like what some of you sisters be doing, secretly sexing. So when you apply Exodus 22:16, how you deal with a sister? You deal with her like a hoe. You sisters that allow brothers in IUIC to come in your DM and seduce you and go around the father and have sex with you on the low: that brother is dealing with you as a hoe. I bet you he said, I'm going to marry you afterwards, and he never did, he never came to no one. It been four years, five years, you and that brother secretly having sex, and then the brother looking at another sister. Why is he having sex with you? Because he treating you as a hoe. You a sex object. He's just sexing you. Secretly, you are being dealt with as a hoe.

Don't think every brother that's in IUIC is right. Some of these brothers ain't right, and they will treat you as a hoe -- and when we find out, he got to go, and you got to go after he treat you as a hoe. You do not have sex with a man's daughter secretly. Don't be giving it up to these brothers that promise you they going to marry you. Go to the fathers. Go to the elders.

“Be not jealous over the wife of thy bosom, and teach her not an evil lesson against thyself.” Don't teach a woman an evil lesson about yourself.

Here is what that means. If you as a man go around the father and you have sex with that sister, and then you tell her, okay, I'll marry you, then when you all got found out you have taught her an evil lesson about yourself. You never respected her father, you never respected the men in the congregation enough to come to them and ask them for the sister's hand in marriage. So why you think she going to respect you? Brother, my wife she don't listen to me, she don't respect me -- because you went about things the wrong way. You taught her an evil lesson about yourself. You taught her, I don't respect none of these guys, I do what the hell I want. So she don't respect you, and she will do whatever she want, and both of y'all could stay there and have your chaotic marriage.

Those of you that did backdoor weddings, back door marriages, sneaking around having sex with each other and then you all get married: when you are going through your problems, don't come to me, and you officers, don't waste your time dealing with them. Because unless they really go to the Lord and ask for forgiveness, that marriage be a disaster. It'd be chaos. It'd be disrespect right through that marriage. Go to the Lord and ask the Lord for forgiveness, go to the fathers and repent and ask the fathers for blessings -- that's if you all want it to work.

“Defraud ye not one the other, except it be with consent for a time, that ye may give yourselves to fasting and prayer; and come together again, that Satan tempt you not for your incontinency.” A lot of times when brothers and sisters mad at each other you say, I ain't giving you none, you ain't getting none of this, because I'm mad at you. That's called defraud. Fraudulent activity. Except it be with consent for a time, that ye may give yourselves to fasting and prayer -- that is the only exception.

Well, sister, that's a dangerous game you playing. You mad at him for a week, for a month, you all ain't talking. Guess who is not mad at him? Satan. Big booty Betty on his job. So now your husband going to work. What happens when a marriage is dishonourable, husband and wife arguing and fighting with each other, and the sister hold it back and say I'm not giving you none? Satan will tempt your husband.

So if you sisters stay there and be stupid, then come to us crying -- Deacon, my husband committed adultery on me -- and the brother says, yo, it been six months, she ain't gave me none, there it is. Go to your husband. Your husband is in the midst of fornication, he got to go, we going to kick him out of the school. But you got to go too, because you in the midst of sin too. You was holding it back from him, you wasn't giving him none, so you open the door for Satan to enter into the marriage. So now the bed is defiled, because that marriage is not honourable.

An honourable sister going to make sure that even if she angry at her husband, she going to still give him some and make sure she like it when she give him some, and put a smile on her face and give him some.

sense.text:
“Likewise, ye husbands, dwell with them according to knowledge, giving honour unto the wife, as unto the weaker vessel”. So you husbands, deal with the wife according to knowledge. Deal with the woman according to knowledge. And you give honour to your wife knowing that she is weaker than you.

It's easy for Satan to mess with your wife's spirit. Satan be jumping on these sisters real easy. All of a sudden your wife in the house walking around and she ain't saying nothing. You're like, yo, what happened to you? Nothing. Second day, she ain't saying nothing, walking around, you're like, yo, you good? Nothing. The silent treatment these women do, Satan be jumping on them. So they are the weaker vessel. It's easy for Satan to jump on woman; they are very emotional. So deal with them like that, and know that they are the weaker vessel.

“and as being heirs together of the grace of life; that your prayers be not hindered.” You all are heirs together; we both are heirs together to the way of life. Because when you don't agree together, God ain't going to hear your prayers. When you and your wife is arguing all the time and you all disagree all the time, you can't pray to the Lord. The Lord is not going to hear your prayers, because that marriage is dishonourable.

“Finally, be ye all of one mind, having compassion one of another, love as brethren, be pitiful, be courteous”. The Bible says to have compassion one to another, and to love each other as brethren. Love. Get that real love, no fake love. Brothers got to love their wives, wives got to love their brothers. You got to love like brethren.

Be pitiful, be courteous. Sometime your wife might do something dumb and stupid, and you don't go level 10 all the time. The food is salty, she put too much salt in the food, and you went to level 10. No, you got to be pitiful, courteous. You're like, yo, don't do that again.

“Not rendering evil for evil, or railing for railing: but contrariwise blessing; knowing that ye are thereunto called, that ye should inherit a blessing.” She say some evil to you, you say something evil to her. No. Brothers, you got to control what come out of your mouth, because words does hurt. When we say evil, we're talking about you calling out names, evil, wicked names, and she's saying wicked, evil, disrespectful stuff. God says it shouldn't be like that.

Railing for railing: you yelling at her, she yelling at you, she lifting her voice, you lifting your voice. Peter, by the spirit of Christ, said we should not be living like that. God says we should not be rolling like that.

But contrariwise blessing. Sister, your husband yell at you, and you say, Most High Christ bless you, I'm sorry. That's it. Not, well, I did it because you -- no. Because we are called to inherit the kingdom of heaven. That's what this is all about. And you ain't going to inherit the kingdom if you got a big loud mouth and are disrespectful.

“For he that will love life, and see good days, let him refrain his tongue from evil, and his lips that they speak no guile”. If you love life, and you want good days -- you want good days in your marriage, you want to have an honourable marriage -- then refrain your tongue from speaking evil against each other, from saying evil to your spouse.

Sometime your wife might say something and you might want to say something to her that's evil. Control it, refrain your tongue. Because if you say something evil to your wife, she going to hold that for years. Even if you say you sorry, she going to hold on to that.

When they say evil stuff to us, we forget about it afterwards. She might give you a little nookie or go a little extra with it and you forgot what you was mad about. But these sisters, they be holding on. You say something evil to them, and even though you say you sorry, they hold on to it for years: ten years ago you called me a name, and I told you I'm sorry, but you did say it.

“Let him eschew evil, and do good; let him seek peace, and ensue it.” Eschew evil -- get rid of evil and do good. When evil come in your marriage, get rid of it. Don't give in to it.

Sometime women do stupid stuff and get you angry, but even in being angry you got to control what you say. Control what you say. Satan plays with their emotion; don't allow him to play with your emotion.

“For the eyes of the Lord are over the righteous, and his ears are open unto their prayers: but the face of the Lord is against them that do evil.” So God's ears is open. You got to know that, because when you dealing evil with your spouse and your spouse pray to the Lord, the Lord hears it.

And if you do evil, if you deal evil with your spouse, the Lord's face is against you.

“And the Lord God said, It is not good that the man should be alone; I will make him an help meet for him.” So God says it's not good for man to be alone. A lot of you brothers is alone, you're lonely, you're so lonely, and it's not good.

“I will make him an help meet for him.” I will make him a good help. Sisters, you were created to help us. That's why you were created: as a companion for us, to help us. Your job is to help us.

So God saw Adam and he said it's not good for Adam to be alone, I'm going to give Adam help, somebody to help him. Adam's job was to serve God, and Eve's job was to serve Adam.

“And Adam gave names to all cattle, and to the fowl of the air, and to every beast of the field; but for Adam there was not found an help meet for him.”

There was nobody to help him. He was by himself. He was created alone, and there was nobody to help him.

“And the Lord God caused a deep sleep to fall upon Adam, and he slept: and he took one of his ribs, and closed up the flesh instead thereof; And the rib, which the Lord God had taken from man, made he a woman, and brought her unto the man.” So the rib he took from Adam, he made woman. He took a rib from Adam and he made a woman.

“and brought her unto the man.” He brought her and gave her to Adam. That's the marriage right there. She was taken out of Adam, she's part of Adam, and the Most High gave her to Adam: yo, this is you right here, brethren.

“And Adam said, This is now bone of my bones, and flesh of my flesh: she shall be called Woman, because she was taken out of Man.” So Adam call her woman. That's what he call her, as a species.

“because she was taken out of Man.” So woman mean from man. Woman came from man. That's what the term woman mean: you came from us.

precepts.why:
“And Adam called his wife's name Eve; because she was the mother of all living.” She was called woman, but now Adam name her. He gave her a name. He said, okay, you a woman, and I'm going to name you Eve, because you are the mother of all living.

So that's what Eve mean. That's her name. She's a woman, but her name is Eve, meaning she's the mother of all living -- meaning everything alive came from Eve.

And yes, Eve was a black woman. Adam was a black man.

sense.text:
“He that getteth a wife beginneth a possession”. If you get a wife, you get a possession. So your wife is your possession. That's why, back in Genesis, the Lord gave her to Adam; he brought her to Adam and he gave her to Adam.

The reason why it says you beginneth a possession is because just getting a woman alone, that ain't it. The possession you getting, you might got to do some rehab work. You going to have to teach her, you're going to have to guide her, you're going to have to correct her, you're going to have to protect her. The same thing you do with your possession. You got a house: you got cameras all around the house, you got grills to stop anybody from breaking in, you put up a fence around your house to prevent animals and things from coming in, and you make sure your house is clean. A possession, you take care of it.

So the same thing with a wife. You get a wife, you got to teach her how to be godly. When she go off, you got to correct her. You got to build her up, to be just like you. Because she's a help; her job is to help you, her job is to serve you.

“Wives, submit yourselves unto your own husbands, as unto the Lord.” So you are to submit yourself unto your husband, as unto the Lord. The same way how the man submit to the Lord, the woman supposed to submit herself unto her husband.

When it says wives, submit yourself to your husband, it means you listen to your husband, and it also mean you serve your husband, you be a good help unto him.

A lot of sisters hear that and say, I ain't serving no man, I'm not a slave. Some of you sisters going to be angry at this class, some of y'all going to be mad, some of y'all might be walking out the door right now: I ain't know about that serving no man stuff. But that is it. And when it says serve, it is not saying you a slave.

“For the husband is the head of the wife, even as Christ is the head of the church”. The husband is the head of the wife. He is her Lord.

The same way how Christ is the head of the nation of Israel, and the head of the man.

precepts.why:
“Now I praise you, brethren, that ye remember me in all things, and keep the ordinances, as I delivered them to you.” Keep the ordinances the same way how they were delivered to you. So what is the ordinance that you got to keep? “But I would have you know, that the head of every man is Christ; and the head of the woman is the man.”

Now the man's job is to do what? Christ's job is to do what? Christ does the service to the Father. He serve God. And us as the men, we got to go through Christ to get to the Father. So when it come to our woman, why don't they understand that the same way how we have to serve Christ, they got to serve us the same way? That's because America have destroyed our people's mind. The woman cannot go to the Lord on her own; they got to go through us, through the man or the leader.

That's why Paul said, the same way how I deliver these ordinances to you, keep them. There is structure and order. There is the Father, there is Christ, there is man, and there is woman. And that's the divine order, and everyone have to do service to the next.

“And ye my flock, the flock of my pasture, are men”. Men. So who is the one God used to do his service? Who is the one that did the sacrifice in the temple and was doing the service of God? Was it woman doing sacrifice, lighting the incense and doing the service of God in the temple? It was always men.

So what service does the woman do? They serve the man, and the man serve God. And the man guide her, and we serve God together. Yes, sister, it is your job to serve your husband. It's your job to be a servant to your husband, the same way how we as men are servants to the Lord. And it's our job to present you holy before our Lord, to make sure that you are right.

This is going to run some up out of here: you ain't going to hear about none of the 144,000 that were sealed being women. Because the woman served the men and the men serve God, and in her serving her man, her man is godly, and they serve God together. That was Eve's job -- to be a help meet unto Adam. Adam was serving God, and she turn around and learn something else from somebody else.

“Because thou servedst not the Lord thy God with joyfulness, and with gladness of heart, for the abundance of all things; Therefore shalt thou serve thine enemies”. This scripture is talking about us serving the Lord with joyfulness, and it is used here in this context: who is the Lord of the woman? The man. So your wife is supposed to serve you with joyfulness and with gladness of heart, for the abundance of all things.

You work nine to five and you come home and you put a roof over her head, pay the phone bill, buy her clothes, buy her food. You give her everything she need. That's all we work for: to take care of the wife and the kids. That's why we work hard, to give them everything.

Christ referred to marriage as the church. The church is married to Christ, and marriage is a great mystery because it's really talking about Christ and us. That's why it is used in this context. The Lord is talking about Israel serving him with joyfulness for all the things he gave them -- but it's supposed to be the same way with our wives. Our wives supposed to serve us with joyfulness.

When we go against our order, when we don't serve our Lord with joyfulness, our woman also disrespect us and go against us. Here it is. “They kept neither lives nor marriages any longer undefiled: but either one slew another traitorously, or grieved him by adultery.” Marriage is no longer kept undefiled, meaning brothers and sisters in the midst of adultery.

Read on: “So that there reigned in all men without exception blood, manslaughter, theft, and dissimulation, corruption, unfaithfulness, tumults, perjury, Disquieting of good men, forgetfulness of good turns, defiling of souls, changing of kind, disorder in marriages, adultery, and shameless uncleanness.” Disorder in marriages -- that's the point. A woman don't respect her husband, she disrespect her husband. Adultery -- she committed adultery on her husband. And all kind of shamelessness.

“For the worshipping of idols not to be named is the beginning, the cause, and the end, of all evil.” So all this happened. Why? Because the men start worshipping idols. So the evil where women don't respect men, disorder in marriage, adultery -- it all comes from worshipping idols. Why? Because when we as men go against our Lord, our woman turn against us. That's the order, the structure.

“Then he said unto them, Go your way, eat the fat, and drink the sweet, and send portions unto them for whom nothing is prepared: for this day is holy unto our Lord: neither be ye sorry; for the joy of the Lord is your strength.” This is talking about Israel as a whole worshipping the Lord, and it is used here too because Christ and the church is relevant to a man and his wife.

“for the joy of the Lord is your strength.” Sisters, you want to know why your marriage is weak, why your spirit is weak all the time? Because you don't have no joy serving your Lord. Sisters must have joy in serving their Lord. When you cook the food, put your spirit into it, your heart in it. That's where you find strength; that's what's going to make you happy. Some sisters always happy, they happy to do stuff with their husband, they cooking, they make sure the clothes is ironed and the house is clean -- they have joy in what they are doing, in the service they are doing for their husband.

So when they cook, don't just cook no regular thing, put your spirit into it. When you're giving him some, put your spirit into it. Brothers don't want no boring sex. If you have some joy, you're going to keep your marriage honourable, and the bed will not be defiled. Have some joy when your husband come home: how you doing, babe, how was your day? Give him a massage and love doing it. Sex should not be burdensome or a chore. Some woman watches sex as a chore -- let me know, he's coming home, I got to give him some, I know he going to want it. It should be something you enjoy and love doing. Brothers, any time your woman acting like it's a chore, something ain't right.

Here is a nugget for you sisters. If your man want to have sex with you all the time, that mean he's attracted to you, that bond is there. But if your man don't want to have sex with you all the time, something is wrong, sister, and you better examine that. The same way you want your lights turned on, your stove to turn on, heat in your house, a roof over your head, clothes on your back, fuel in your car -- we want fuel in our car too. Once your husband want to have sex with you, that's a compliment, sisters.

“Then said Judith unto him, Who am I now, that I should gainsay my lord? surely whatsoever pleaseth him I will do speedily, and it shall be my joy unto the day of my death.” Whatsoever pleaseth him I will do speedily -- and it shall be my joy, unto the day of my death. That is the same thing read in Ephesians, that wives submit yourselves unto your husband in everything.

Now she talking to this heathen dude and she was running game on him, but the state of mind is the point. This is the state of mind that a sister should have towards her husband: whatever you say, I'm going to do it, and I will do it joyfully, until the day I die.

That's the way how women think back then. Their job was to serve their husbands. Them Christians be talking about till death do us part -- this should be what it really is. And that's what it mean when it says that Eve was a help meet. Your job as a help meet is to serve your husband.

sense.text:
“Notwithstanding she shall be saved in childbearing, if they continue in faith and charity and holiness with sobriety.” The woman will be saved in childbearing. If she continue in faith, meaning if she believe, and if she deal right with the congregation, deal right with her fellow sisters, deal right with her brothers.

But the point out of this is that she shall be saved in childbearing. What does that mean? A woman will be saved in childbearing. Do that mean she sit down and pop out babies and she gonna be saved when Christ return? No.

precepts.why:
“Unto the woman he said, I will greatly multiply thy sorrow and thy conception; in sorrow thou shalt bring forth children”. In sorrow thou shalt bring forth children -- this is the childbearing. She bringeth forth children.

“and thy desire shall be to thy husband, and he shall rule over thee.” Her desire should be unto her husband, and he shall rule over her.

So what is this going into? It's going into her being a good wife, her guiding the house, being a good wife. When it says she shall be saved in childbearing, it means being a good wife, serving your husband, being a good wife -- that's what it's going into. Serving your Lord, that's how you going to be saved. You be a good wife to your Lord, you guide the house, you honour your Lord.

“I will therefore that the younger women marry, bear children, guide the house, give none occasion to the adversary to speak reproachfully.” This goes into childbearing. Let the younger woman marry -- this is God's plan. Marry, bear children, have children for that man, guide the house, take care of that man and the kids, and give none occasion to the adversary to speak reproachfully.

What is she doing here? She's serving a man. She's cooking, cleaning, taking care of the house, taking care of the kids. She is a help meet unto her Lord. She is serving a man. I ain't going to be no slave, I ain't cooking and cleaning and taking care of no house and having no kids for no man -- you independent woman, you going to die here in Babylon.

But this is the good way God says that a woman should be. That's what it mean when it says she shall be saved in childbearing. She got to guide the house. That's how she's saved in childbearing: being a good wife, a godly good wife.

sense.text:
“Who can find a virtuous woman? for her price is far above rubies.” Who could find a good wife, a good woman? Her price is above rubies.

These are the signs to find a good woman.

“The heart of her husband doth safely trust in her, so that he shall have no need of spoil.” You a good woman, and you will be trusted in.

“so that he shall have no need of spoil.” You ain't worrying about another man coming and defiling your woman, having sex with her.

“She will do him good and not evil all the days of her life.”

Why is it saying she will do him good and not evil? Because it's her job to serve him. She doing right by him.

“She is like the merchants' ships; she bringeth her food from afar.”

She go and buy food from far and bring food to the house from far.

“She riseth also while it is yet night, and giveth meat to her household”. So she get up while it's dark, five in the morning, and she cook for her family, cook for her husband.

This is what it means that she shall be saved in childbearing: she being a good wife.

And some of you brothers get up and go to work and you don't even got your lunch packed, you can't even get some coffee. She ain't even getting up and saying, let me make my Lord some coffee. You got to go to work for seven, so she get up at six and make sure -- no, she's saying, yo, you got to get it yourself. But these is the qualities you look for in a good wife.

“She considereth a field, and buyeth it: with the fruit of her hands she planteth a vineyard.”

She able to consider a field and come to you and say, yo, my Lord, look at this field, I think we should get it.

“She openeth her mouth with wisdom; and in her tongue is the law of kindness.” She open her mouth with wisdom.

“and in her tongue is the law of kindness.” She is kind. Some of you sisters can't spell kind.

“She looketh well to the ways of her household, and eateth not the bread of idleness.” She looketh well to the ways of her household.

This is a virtuous woman. This is her serving her Lord, her man. That's your job, sisters: your job is to serve your man. That's what it mean -- you are a help meet unto him, your job is to serve him. Our job is to serve God, and we serve the Lord together.

“and eateth not the bread of idleness.” She ain't idle. She occupied doing something to help her Lord.

“Her children arise up, and call her blessed; her husband also, and he praiseth her.” The kids say, mom, you blessed.

And her husband praise her: yo, you a good woman, you a good wife, all the things you doing, you help me with this, you help me with that, you make sure me and the kids eat every day, you take care of the house.

“Nevertheless let every one of you in particular so love his wife even as himself; and the wife see that she reverence her husband.” The first sign of a good woman is respect.

The key thing all men hate is disrespect. Men hate disrespect from their woman. We don't want that, we don't play with that -- at least a godly man don't. A godly man ain't going to take no disrespect from no woman: no mouth, no talk back, no slick. Those of y'all that simps might take a woman's disrespect, but we ain't taking no disrespect from no woman. Brothers, do not allow your woman to disrespect you.

What does the word reverence mean? Reverence is deep respect for someone or something. So your woman should have deep respect for you, man. You can't be gay about it -- she your woman there disrespecting you, saying slick stuff, and you just let it go, acting like no, no, no. You got to correct that, brother. Your woman must have deep respect for you, and a woman that have deep respect for you, that's a good wife.

Sarah showed her husband reverence and respect. Even though she and Abraham got into an argument, she still called him Lord and showed him reverence and respect, and she gave way for the Lord to judge that matter. And whose daughters are you all?

The next sign is a woman's desire being unto her husband. A woman's desire unto her husband is really going into a woman's job to serve her husband and to please her husband. That's what it mean, her desire is unto you. You all know when sisters cook and they stand up over you to see, waiting for you to taste the food to see how it tastes, just watching you while you eating, just for you to say, damn, this is good -- that's a sign of a woman's desire being unto you. A woman that want to have sex with you, that's another desire. If your woman don't want to have sex with you, something wrong; her desire is not unto you. She must be craving you. When you're not at home, she can't sleep.

“And pulled off the sackcloth which she had on, and put off the garments of her widowhood, and washed her body all over with water, and anointed herself with precious ointment, and braided the hair of her head, and put on a tire upon it, and put on her garments of gladness, wherewith she was clad during the life of Manasses her husband.” So Judith took off the sackcloth and the garments of her widowhood, and she put on her garments of gladness -- the clothes she used to wear while her husband was alive. When her husband was alive it had a certain way she dressed. She washed herself and anointed herself with precious ointment and braided her hair and put a tire on it; she put herself together, and everybody went crazy over her. So the way a woman dress also tells if her desire is unto her husband.

Why is this important? When a woman start getting fat, overweight, stop taking care of herself, her desire is not unto you. And don't get me wrong, sisters put on weight; as time goes on everybody put on weight. But when you just overeating and you get obese, unattractive, your desire is not unto your husband. You don't even put on some nice lingerie or something nice to try to appease your man. Something ain't right with you.

Because a woman dress to please who? A woman ain't supposed to dress nice to go out with her friends, or to go on a job interview, or to look good for a boss at work. A woman's supposed to dress nice for her man. She's supposed to look good for you. But what these black women do, they look good for everybody but their men; when they come home they put some crap over their face and put on some regular and come around you like that.

The next sign that a woman is a good wife is when she take accountability for her actions.

“And the Lord God said unto the woman, What is this that thou hast done? And the woman said, The serpent beguiled me, and I did eat.” So what is the first thing Eve did when she took part in that evil and the Lord busted her and asked her what she did? She point the finger at Satan. She said it's the devil. She did not take accountability.

Guess what, it's the same thing with sisters today. A lot of you sisters does not want to take accountability. You do something wrong, you do all messed up, and you never take accountability and say, I'm wrong, I shouldn't have did this, I shouldn't have did that. You blame your husband -- it's because you said this to me, or you did this, that's why I did that. No. Just take accountability for what you did. That's it.

“The grace of a wife delighteth her husband, and her discretion will fatten his bones.” The grace of a wife, it delight her husband. You sisters that have grace -- grace, mercy -- it delights your husband.

“and her discretion will fatten his bones.” Your discretion will fatten his bones.

“A silent and loving woman is a gift of the Lord”. That's a gift from God. That's a gift, brothers, to have a woman that's silent.

And when it says silent, it ain't talking about her walking around the house with tape over her mouth when her husband come home, like those videos going around. It ain't talking about that. It's talking about you are not argumentative. You listen. You serve your husband, you serve your Lord, you listen, you're not argumentative, you're not being evil. That's a blessing from God: you helping your man, your man serving God, and you are helping your man in serving God, making sure he good, he all right.

“and there is nothing so much worth as a mind well instructed.” A mind well instructed, meaning the sister is instructed by her husband and she listened to her husband. The Lord love to see that.

“A shamefaced and faithful woman is a double grace, and her continent mind cannot be valued.” A shamefaced woman: you ain't up in everybody's face. And faithful: you faithful to your man, you know you faithful to your man.

“is a double grace.” That's double grace from God. The Lord show you mercy, brother. And her continent mind cannot be valued.

“As the sun when it ariseth in the high heaven; so is the beauty of a good wife in the ordering of her house.” When the sun is shining in the high heaven, twelve o'clock, the sun bright in the sky -- so is the beauty of a good wife in the ordering of her house.

To order her house is what? If she's ordering her house, she's serving her husband, she's serving her Lord, she order her house and serve her man.

For you wicked black woman that say, I ain't serving no man, I ain't cooking, I ain't cleaning -- this is what God says.

“As the clear light is upon the holy candlestick; so is the beauty of the face in ripe age.” The clear light upon the holy candlestick is the menorah.

So is the beauty of her face in ripe age -- her beauty in old age. Because as she get old, she like fine wine. Why? Because the Most High bless her. Some of you sisters is blessed: when you get old you are like fine wine, your age is beauty, through your wisdom and all of that that you have learned and your guiding of your house. Because it's showing your continence.

Then you got someone that's thirty years old and they look like sixty, busted, and you're like, what's going on? You done get ran out and ran through and been to the club all your life.
